_about: Module definitions for the haulers group (A4: the Drone Cage, the Warren reworked). See logistics.json for the shape.

modules.name: Drone Cage
modules.blurb: A bolted cage of four drones. They fly out to loose powder anywhere in a square of ground round the cage, scoop up a handful, bring it back and drop it into the cage, which passes it up out of its top face into a Tank, Funnel or Chute joined there. They only ever lift loose powder, and fly over anything. Each trip costs a little power; needs a Node or the Hub in reach. Click it to change the size of the square.
